resources.string: Buzzes your phone before your stop, so you don’t miss it.
SamFran needs your location to know when you’re near the stop. Allow it in the phone’s settings.
Feel that? On a ride it keeps going until you tap Stop, here or on the notification, even with the phone locked.
Just once. It’s kept for every ride.
When you get on. Then lock the phone and rest.
It keeps buzzing until you tap “Stop”.
Pretend you’ve dozed off… it buzzes %s before the stop.
On a real ride, tap “I’m on the bus” when you get on. That’s all.
You can lock the phone. It stops by itself after three hours.
Plenty of time to wake up.
On a fast road, choose more.
Tap “I’m on the bus” when you get on. “Try it now” is a six-second practice.
Buzz this far before the stop
This phone asks “Start bus alarm?” when a shift on the Shifts tab ends. One tap starts it.
Allow notifications for SamFran in the phone’s settings, then switch this on again.
Type part of it, e.g. 葵西
The stop search isn’t answering. Paste a Google Maps link instead.
No stops by that name. Try fewer characters, written as on the stop’s sign.
Start typing and choose your stop from the list.
Found it on OpenStreetMap, by its name.
Paste a Google Maps link to the stop
Use where I am now (stand at the stop)
Couldn’t find where that stop is. In Google Maps, press and hold on the stop to drop a pin, then share that pin’s link.
Couldn’t tell where you are. Check that location is on, and allowed for SamFran.
